mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pool_id FROM ip_pool_auto_rule WHERE rule_type = 'auto_out' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND si.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND si.maturity_date <> '' AND si.maturity_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND bond.issuer_code <> '' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date > CURDATE()) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_temp_security_code ts WHERE ts.temp_security_code = bond.wind_code AND ts.security_code IS NOT NULL AND ts.security_code <> '' AND IFNULL(ts.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ts.status = 'updated' ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT t.s_info_compcode AS security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(t.s_info_compname, ''), t.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type FROM ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.s_info_compcode ORDER BY r.ann_dt2 DESC ,r.ann_dt DESC ,r.object_id DESC ) AS rn FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode <> '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating <> '' ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.b_info_creditrating IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = t.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY t.s_info_compcode ASC

SELECT t.s_info_compcode AS security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(t.s_info_compname, ''), t.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type FROM ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.s_info_compcode ORDER BY r.ann_dt2 DESC ,r.ann_dt DESC ,r.object_id DESC ) AS rn FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode <> '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating <> '' ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.b_info_creditrating NOT IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = t.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY t.s_info_compcode ASC
